name: travel-brief
description: One-shot pre-travel brief for any city: 7-day weather forecast, geolocation context for a reference IP, and a scannable QR code linking to the destination - paid per call in USDC, no API keys.

location.description: City or place name for the weather forecast (e.g. "Jakarta", "London", "Mount Bromo") - used as ${location} in the weather step body.

ip.description: Reference IPv4 address for the geolocation step (e.g. a server or exit-node IP to sanity-check) - used as ${ip} in the ip-geo step body.

data.description: Text or URL to encode into the QR code (e.g. a maps link for the destination) - used as ${data} in the qr step body.

steps.label: 7-day weather forecast - payapi.market (x402 via SELAT Router)
IP geolocation context - ip-geo-api (x402 via SELAT Router)
Destination QR code - klymax402 (x402 via SELAT Router)
